title: Key inverse-Lipschitz inequality for graph-plane projections: 2|A - B|^2 <= (1 + ||A||^2)(1 + ||B||^2)|P_A - P_B|^2
statement: For all n, l, every linear isometry (linear isometric equivalence) q of R^(n+l) = Amb n l, and all continuous linear A, B : R^n -> R^l: let P_A and P_B be the orthogonal projections (starProjection) of R^(n+l) onto G_A = q(span{graphPoint(v, A v) : v in R^n}) and G_B = q(span{graphPoint(v, B v) : v in R^n}). Then 2 hsNormSq(A - B) <= (1 + ||A||^2)(1 + ||B||^2) hsNormSq(P_A - P_B). Here hsNormSq M = sum_i |M e_i|^2 over the standard basis of the domain of M (for P_A - P_B, the standard basis of R^(n+l)), and ||.|| is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), 2 * hsNormSq (A - B) ≤ (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2) * (1 + ‖B‖ ^ 2) * hsNormSq ((Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection - (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v)))).starProjection)
